shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Filed as general: this is his 2000 Decipher World Championship Dark deck, already on the wiki from Decipher Deck Designs as [[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe DS]]. The strategy says: "i have play this deck in day 2, 3-1 lost to Brain Rippetoe because i lost a huge sac war and day 3, 3-0 with the final". The DeckTech list differs slightly from Deck Designs (here Sense x6, You Cannot Hide Forever and a 'grabbler'; Deck Designs has Sense x5, Oppressive Enforcement and There'll Be Hell To Pay x2).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting Crap8': the Objective, Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, You Cannot Hide Forever, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Death Star II: Throne Room and 'starting interrupt card'; they count toward the 60 (total 60 as published). Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Posted 'starting interrupt card' (unnamed) dested Prepared Defenses: the only BHBM starting interrupt of the time, and the Deck Designs copy of this deck lists Prepared Defenses.

Posted 'papatine( puppet)' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'janus( god )' Janus Greejatus; 'slim aloo' Sim Aloo; 'mara jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'jabba the pizza' Jabba The Hutt; 'fett w stick' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle (as in the Deck Designs list); 'ig88 w stick' IG-88 With Riot Gun.

Posted 'deadnut' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'suckass in boat' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'bossk in boat' / 'dengar in boat' Bossk In Hound's Tooth / Dengar In Punishing One; 'mara stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'vader stick' Vader's Lightsaber; 'circle now complete' The Circle Is Now Complete; 'twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'imp barrier' Imperial Barrier; Battle Order is the Endor Effect.
Posted 'd2db' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'space portdb' Spaceport Docking Bay; 'endordb' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay).
Posted 'grabbler' kept as written (UNKNOWN): it names no card.
player_note: Deck Designs published his final Worlds Dark list as [[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe DS]]; this posted version differs by a few cards.
